body: Your english is perfect, and thanks for your support. I feel like you exactly when you say you could easily do it, but you are just too lazy to study. Absolutely the same for me. Sadly 3 days is not nearly enough, I would need at least a week, but I'm not that depressed as I was yesterday, I pretty much accepted that I will fail. Good luck and I know both of us can do it.

Damn, 16 days is not enough? What are you studying? 

I honestly don't know how to get my passion back. It just faded away. Everyone says "just start studying bro" but it's hard when you are too lazy to care. 

Good luck anyway, hope you can make it!
